description: PLA page-level funnel for a marketplace over a period: requests, non-zero responses, response rate, impressions, clicks and marketplace-currency spend. Group by page_type for the page-type breakdown (page-level performance and page RR) or by date for the daily request/response trend used in budget-utilisation debugging. Rows with a null, blank or 'NA' page_type are excluded, matching all three retired reports.

page_type.description: The surface the ad served on (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...).

date.description: Calendar date of the PLA page-level facts row. Group by this for the daily request / response trend.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Ad requests received on this page type.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses).

response_rate.selector: ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)), 2)
response_rate.description: Non-zero responses as a percentage of requests for this grouping.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions served on this page type.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Ad clicks on this page type.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN pf.cost_usd * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend on this page type, converted to the marketplace currency.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_product_ads_page_name_performance_facts AS pf JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON pf.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id LEFT JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND pf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND pf.page_type IS NOT NULL AND pf.page_type NOT IN ('', 'NA') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
